licence: NASA POWER data are in the public domain, attribution requested
principal_rule: the most populous city in the cell, lowest GeoNames id breaking a tie
what: cities grouped by the NASA POWER grid cell whose twelve-month normals they carry, keyed on a hash of the vector itself rather than on coordinates
why: NASA POWER climatology is gridded at about half a degree, so every city in a cell carries byte-identical normals and a per-city climate page repeats the same answer under a different name
